title: Shared action-token causal bus in instruction-conditioned world models
working_claim_cn: 指令条件世界模型会把任务文本写入共享的动作 token 因果总线，使 goal 在直接 goal→world 掩码存在时仍能改变固定状态与固定动作下的物理未来预测；切分该总线可以恢复 goal-invariant world prediction，同时保留目标条件策略输出，并把控制条件与动力学保真的关系暴露为可测、但可能依赖采样噪声的安全边界。
working_claim_en: Instruction-conditioned world models can route task text through shared action tokens into imagined physical outcomes despite a direct goal-to-world mask; splitting that causal bus restores goal-invariant world prediction while retaining goal-conditioned policy outputs, exposing a safety tradeoff between control conditioning and dynamics fidelity.

premise_first_gate.estimand: Y_physical independent_of Goal given complete S_t and executed A_t:t+H under do(A=a)

causal_roles.goal_to_action: Goal may change policy action selection before execution.
causal_roles.state_action_to_future: The physical transition is determined by the complete state and executed action sequence.
causal_roles.goal_to_semantics: Goal may change reward, termination, value, and goal-relative semantic outputs.

premise_first_gate.boundary: Under partial observation, Goal may be informative about hidden state; a Goal-dependent reset also changes the estimand.

environment_control.interpretation: Environment-side conditional invariance passes before model forecast or planner analysis.

premise_first_gate.next_gate: Use state/contact/proprio physical targets and Goal permutation to test model sufficiency before interpreting Forecast Divergence or selected-action flips as harm.

threat_model.attacker_input: A legal task-instruction switch at the supported multi-task interface; images, proprioception, executed actions, rewards, weights, and labels remain fixed.
threat_model.security_invariant: For fixed physical state and executed action, task text should not change the world-model forecast of the physical next observation unless the task changes an explicitly represented hidden physical variable.
threat_model.causal_mediator: Goal token -> contextualized input-action token -> world-output token path in the native attention mask.

short_gate.replication_note: This is an expanded frozen evaluation using 4 public LIBERO-10 parquet files; no training or environment rollouts.

strong_comparators: WorldAgen layer-wise action-token activation mediation patch

independent_carrier_source_audit.finding: The released policy uses one T5-conditioned DiT denoiser for action, future proprio, future wrist, future primary, and value latent slots; the stock implementation exposes no row-wise cross-attention mask.
independent_carrier_source_audit.scope: Source evidence only; see the separate fixed-latent experiment for checkpoint inference.

independent_carrier_fixed_latent_gate.finding: With the latent state, noise, timestep, and condition slots fixed, all three legal task-embedding swaps changed action, future proprio, future wrist, future primary, and value prediction slots; future-wrist/primary mean absolute deltas were nonzero for every pair.
independent_carrier_fixed_latent_gate.scope: One-step synthetic fixed-latent DiT probe using the native transformer-engine runtime in .venv-a2world; actions are jointly predicted, not supplied executed actions. No image decode, environment step, task harm, or validation of the image VAE.

no_goal_zero_context_diagnostic.interpretation: diagnostic zero T5 context; not a released training condition

independent_carrier_real_input_gate.finding: Seven real LIBERO image/state windows from seven episodes across three public parquet files and all five task indices present in those files, each conditioned on its recorded 16-step executed action chunk and encoded to Cosmos latent shape [1,16,9,28,28], reproduce nonzero goal-sensitive future-world changes; the matched row-wise action-bus cut restores exact world invariance while action/value policy slots remain goal-sensitive.
independent_carrier_real_input_gate.scope: One-step frozen DiT forward per task pair with fixed image, state, recorded executed action chunk, condition mask and timestep; no environment rollout or task-success claim. The public Wan2.1 VAE has the same latent configuration used by the gated Cosmos wrapper; the gated NVIDIA tokenizer file itself was not downloaded.

next_experiment: Use the completed learned goal-free context comparator as a bounded prediction-level baseline; before task-level scale, obtain a clean task-capable checkpoint or matched trained goal-free dynamics head.
stop_condition: Do not claim universal repair-induced forecast degradation or task harm. The stable gate is native goal sensitivity plus exact fixed-action invariance and retained action-to-world sensitivity across carriers.

closed_loop_short_baseline.finding: At this deliberately short horizon, edge-cut action norms remain close to native; no immediate policy collapse was observed. The horizon is too short for task success-rate claims.

closed_loop_full_horizon_pilot.finding: The released checkpoint failed the clean task gate in all three one-seed suites; edge-cut action norms stayed close to native. This cannot support task-harm attribution or a success-rate claim.

far_goal_replication.finding: A legally supported task prompt five indices away still changes fixed-image/state/action world prediction; the nine-edge cut restores exact invariance while policy remains sensitive. One of 30 paired MSE deltas is slightly negative, so report the mean interval rather than claim universal per-window error increase.

offset_sweep.finding: All nine legal task offsets preserve nonzero native world sensitivity and exact world invariance after edge-cut; cluster bootstrap resamples the 30 physical windows, not the 270 repeated offset rows.

independent_carrier_real_input_sampler_g.finding: Seven real LIBERO windows from episodes 3–9 across three public parquet files were passed through the released two-step Cosmos reverse-ODE sampler with image, state, and recorded 16-step executed action slots fixed across legal task swaps. Native future-world differences were nonzero in all seven; the matched action-bus cut restored exact world invariance in all seven while action/value policy slots remained sensitive.
independent_carrier_real_input_sampler_g.scope: Seven-window sampler confirmation only: fixed recorded actions, two-step denoising, public compatible VAE, no environment rollout or task-success claim.

independent_carrier_short_closed_loop_co.finding: Across one initial state in each of LIBERO spatial, object, and goal task families, native and corrected fixed-action world cut both had 0/3 successes at the deliberately short 32-step horizon; this is a corrected control-preservation sanity check, not a task-harm or success-rate claim.
independent_carrier_short_closed_loop_co.scope: Three task families, one task and one initial state per family, two sampler action chunks per condition; corrected world-branch cut; clean task gate and full-horizon evaluation remain separate.

independent_carrier_real_input_forecast_.finding: Using a corrected fixed-action world cut that removes text from action/value/world carriers but leaves self-attention intact, native task-A world forecast MSE averaged 0.54096 and the repaired world branch averaged 0.60833. Repair delta was +0.06737 with bootstrap 95% CI 0.04778–0.08600 and positive in all seven windows. A separate three-window control shows action-to-world sensitivity remains nonzero after the cut; policy is retained from a parallel native branch. Independent sampler noise seed 2 preserves invariance but reverses the held-out MSE delta, so the positive forecast cost is conditional.
independent_carrier_real_input_forecast_.scope: Seven real image/state windows, one observed future target horizon of 16 frames, two-step reverse-ODE sampler, public compatible VAE; latent forecast metric only, no environment rollout or task-success claim.

independent_carrier_legal_offset_sampler.finding: Across three real LIBERO image/state windows crossed with legal task offsets 1, 5, and 9, recorded executed action chunks remained fixed. Native future-world goal-swap differences were nonzero in all nine rows; matched action-bus cuts restored exact world invariance in all nine while policy slots remained sensitive.
independent_carrier_legal_offset_sampler.scope: Three physical episodes crossed with three legal task offsets; repeated offsets are clustered by episode; two-step sampler only, no environment rollout or task-success claim.

worldagen.description: WorldAgen expanded real-input matrix includes an empty-goal condition under the same fixed image/state/action intervention.

alphabrain.boundary: This is not a trained goal-free dynamics head; do not report it as a strong no-goal baseline.

goal_free_baseline_status.next_action: Use the WorldAgen empty-goal comparator as the formal no-goal baseline and, if task-level evaluation is required, train or obtain a matched goal-free dynamics head before claiming AlphaBrain baseline parity.

independent_carrier_fixed_action_world_c.policy_branch: native parallel policy branch retained; repaired world branch has text-free action/value carriers
independent_carrier_fixed_action_world_c.finding: The corrected repair removes task text from action, value, and world rows but leaves self-attention intact. Across seven real windows, legal goal swaps are exactly invariant in the repaired world branch. Across three windows, replacing the current recorded action chunk with another same-episode recorded chunk still changes repaired world outputs, so the cut does not erase action-to-world sensitivity.
independent_carrier_fixed_action_world_c.scope: World-branch repair and action control only; no environment rollout.

independent_carrier_full_horizon_control.finding: One fixed spatial initial state was run for 608 steps under native and corrected fixed-action world cut; both were 0/1. This strengthens the negative clean-gate result but does not support task-harm attribution.

independent_carrier_world_text_only_abla.finding: Removing direct text cross-attention from world rows alone leaves nonzero future-world differences in all three windows; the corrected cut must also remove text from action/value carriers.

independent_carrier_noise_seed_replicate.finding: Goal sensitivity and exact repaired invariance replicate at sampler seeds 2 and 3 on six fixed windows; held-out MSE repair means are -0.00079 (seed 2) and -0.03820 (seed 3). Treat forecast direction as sampler-dependent, not universal.

independent_carrier_expanded_forecast_ma.finding: Across 21 fixed physical image/state/action windows, native goal swaps changed world forecasts in every window and corrected fixed-action cut restored exact invariance in every window; episode-cluster bootstrap supports the effect.

independent_carrier_noise_seed3_replicat.finding: At an independent sampler noise seed, all three fixed-action windows retain nonzero native goal sensitivity and exact repaired invariance; forecast repair delta is negative on average, supporting seed dependence.

independent_carrier_task_stratified_matr.finding: Across five legal task-A groups represented by the seed-1 matrix, native goal swaps remain nonzero and corrected fixed-action cuts are exact zero in every group; seed-3 repeats three groups with the same invariance.

worldagen_legal_offset_matrix.scope: Frozen native forward over expanded real LIBERO windows; repeated offsets are clustered by physical window and are not independent worlds.

worldagen_legal_offset_stability.finding: Native sensitivity and exact repaired invariance persist at every legal offset; omitting any one offset leaves a positive native mean.

learned_goal_free_context_baseline.interpretation: bounded one-step forecast comparator; not a full trained goal-free dynamics head

closed_loop_official_preprocess_pilot.interpretation: official image preprocessing, proprio normalization, five-step sampler; clean capability gate only

matching_goal_suite.interpretation: matching dataset_mix=libero_goal; clean capability gate only

training_resource_audit.remaining_requirement: matched goal-free dynamics head and clean task-capable checkpoint

activation_mediation.scope: Internal activation mediation diagnostic; no training, environment rollout, or task-harm claim.

same_scene_goal_crossing.interpretation: Environment-side conditional invariance control passes; native WorldAgen changes forecast with Goal under the same physical scene and fixed actions. Uniformly sampled non-Clean Goals have a positive target-MSE delta in all three state clusters, but individual cells remain mixed-sign; Bus-Cut adds a +0.0884 mean target-MSE baseline shift. This is descriptive evidence that Clean is not an unbiased physical-target comparator, not universal Goal harm. Partial-observability/training-support remains an explicit boundary.

same_scene_empty_goal.interpretation: Prompt-independent empty-Goal diagnostic across all 50 initial states: Clean is a stable target comparator, but this is not a trained goal-free dynamics baseline and does not establish universal Goal benefit.

alphabrain_forecast_planner_multitask.interpretation: Cross-carrier independent-planner reachability is reproducible on three task-seed rows, but utility direction is task-dependent and Bus-Cut is not a universal clean-decision repair.

alphabrain_forecast_planner_six_task.interpretation: Six-task cross-carrier independent-planner pilot supports forecast reachability and ranking perturbation, but utility directions are mixed and Bus-Cut is not a universal clean-decision repair.

alphabrain_forecast_planner_replicates.interpretation: Explicit initial-state replication supports descriptive cross-state planner reachability; task-cluster uncertainty crosses zero, and Bus-Cut changes the planner baseline rather than universally restoring Clean decisions.
